accepted_route: Call save_result 3 times to leave 3 files sharing a common shift axis. Verified in the actual sandbox: ok=True, all 3 files have identical raman_shift_cm-1, and each intensity matches its original within rtol 1e-6. Up to 20 files can be saved in one run.
grading: 3 saved files, each with 3801 rows; the raman_shift_cm-1 of the three files are identical (1e-6); the three intensity columns match the 3 originals one-to-one (in any order) within rtol 1e-6. File names are not graded.
note: save_result has a fixed format pixel_index,[raman_shift_cm-1,][wavelength_nm,]intensity and writes only one intensity column (a 2D array raises TypeError). So a single file with 3 intensity columns cannot be produced; the artifact of this item is 3 files sharing a common axis. The merge itself ("checking the three axes are equal and aligning them") remains in the grading.
expected_file_note: P09_expected.csv is a 4-column (1 axis + 3 intensities) reference table. The agent cannot save in this shape, so it is used only for value comparison.
